title: Deadline Packet
user: Freelancers earning cross-border income who need a calm, accountant-ready packet of invoices, receipts, deadline notes, and unanswered questions for a specific filing period.
smallest_useful_product: A local-first checklist builder with filing-period folders, attachments, a missing-evidence list, and a zipped/PDF index for accountant handoff.
constraints: No country-specific legal claims; keep documents local; make retention and export explicit; never send documents automatically.
